product_one_liner.value: Owl provides insurance-focused AI that reads claim files and turns documents, signals, and records into structured, cited evidence and insights for claims, SIU, legal, and underwriting teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes claim-file analysis and its target insurance teams.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no pricing link and directs prospects to book a briefing.

named_customers.notes: The success stories anonymize the insurers (for example, “a leading insurer”) and do not name two customers.

employee_band.notes: A company profile reports an employee band of 51-100.

hq_location.notes: Forbes lists Vancouver, Canada as Owl.co headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The funding announcement states Owl.co was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index shows topical insurance/AI articles and announcements, not at least two engineering-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal includes multiple categories and task-oriented guides, including API reference, integrations, model cards, and changelog.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live roles list includes data quality, product, software engineering, solutions engineering, and sales titles, but none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: Owl's own insurance-specific models, including Owl-1.5; no external model provider is publicly identified.
model_provider.notes: Owl documents model cards for Owl-1.5 and describes a custom domain-specific model; its public subprocessors page lists only AWS for cloud hosting.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page names SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and GDPR; it does not name PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook identifies the Series B as $30 million on November 3, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round was the November 2021 Series B, before the 18-month window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists a live Enterprise Account Executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 9, 2026, Owl described Template Assistant as a new feature that adds agentic AI template editing; that date is within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete current executive-team page shows its C-level and VP roster; the available VP of People and CTO profiles date their current Owl roles to 2023 and 2021, respectively, and no appointment or departure in the 12-month window was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integrations documentation names insurance-system connectors, not CRM or sales/marketing systems.
